name: Datamatics Global Services Limited
remarksWeb: Note 1: NCLT, Mumbai Bench vide its order dated February 13, 2024, sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation for the merger of Delta Infosolutions Private Limited (Transferor Company or Delta) with and into Datamatics Global Services Limited (Transferee Company or the Company) and their respective shareholders under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. In accordance with the Scheme, the holding of 3,20,98,742 Equity Shares of Transferor Company in the Transferee Company stands cancelled and the Company has issued and allotted 3,20,98,742 Equity Shares of the Company to the Equity Shareholders of Transferor Company in proportion to their holding in Transferor Company i.e. Dr. Lalit S. Kanodia: 1,06,98,511 equity shares, Mr. Sameer L. Kanodia: 1,06,98,511 equity shares & Vikrant Trust: 1,07,01,720 equity shares.The aforesaid allotment of shares approved by Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on March 21, 2024 Accordingly, we have filed the application with the Stock Exchanges for Listing Approval of 3,20,98,742 Equity Shares. We have received Listing Approval from NSE on April 15, 2024. We are still awaiting approval of BSE. Post receiving the BSE Listing Approval we will initiate the process of corporate action with NSDL/CDSL for crediting/debiting the shares in the respective demat account of the shareholders and then we will file an application for the Trading approval with the stock exchanges. Kindly take the same in your records. Note 2: Lalit S. Kanodia HUF - 2 and Yogendra Kanodia HUF were forming part of Promoter Group Category. Their holdings in the Company is NIL and this two HUFs are dissloved. Hence, we have removed their names from Promoter Group Category. Please take the same in your records.

name: Datamatics Global Services Limited
remarksWeb: Note: 1. Mr. Yogendra Kanodia, the Karta of Yogendra Kanodia HUF, part of the person belonging to the promoter group expired on 30/04/2022. Yogendra Kanodia HUF holds 1475 Equity Shares in the Company as on 31/03/2023 and the said shares are in process of transmission to his legal heirs as on date. Hence 1475 Equity Shares was shown in his name as on 31/03/2023.   2. Mr. Yogendra Kanodia part of the person belonging to the promoter group expired on 30/04/2022. Mr. Yogendra Kanodia was holding 5,870 Equity Shares in the Company as on 30/04/2022. These shares were transferred to Mrs. Rashmi Kanodia (wife of late Yogendra Kanodia) through transmission process in the month of January 2023. As per Regulation 31A(6) of SEBI LODR, in case of transmission of shares held by person belonging to the promoter group, immediately on such event, the recipient of such shares shall be classified as a promoter/ person belonging to the promoter group. Since Mr. Yogendra Kanodias shares were transmitted to Mrs. Rashmi Kanodia (wife of Late Yogendra Kanodia), Mrs. Rashmi Kanodia forms part of the person belonging to the promoter group w.e.f. January, 2023. Further as per regulation 31(A)(6)(c), in case of death of a promoter/ person belonging to the promoter group, such person shall automatically cease to be included as a promoter/ person belonging to the promoter group, so  Mr. Yogendra Kanodia will not  form part of the promoter group.    Further Mrs. Rashmi Kanodia was already holding 2730 shares and was categorized in Resident Individuals holding nominal share capital up to Rs. 2 lakhs, after transmission of 5870 shares of late Mr. Yogendra Kanodia, at present Mrs. Rashmi Kanodia is holding 8600 shares of the Company.
